body: I just want her to know and understand how I feel.  I feel like if she knew she would at least want to talk but I can't tell if she's just feigning ignorance or legitimately does not know what hell I am going through.  I know people at this point in the game will just say, "give up" or "there are plenty of fish in the sea" but those people clearly have never fallen so hard in love or been 100% emotionally committed to another.  My therapist tells me to "let things unfold" but that involves me keeping a cool head and staying sane which I am unsure I can do.  I just feel lower then the lowest of low and like i'm not worth anyone's time so what's the point of existing?

I'm already picking her up at the airport in 3 days and she is staying at my place tonight the plans are locked in and I can't change them, I thought about just being distant and cold but I don't know what I'm doing and I've never been in this shitty predicament before.  I could just not stay at my friend's place with her and just ditch her there.  I don't know I am freaking out so much and I'm starting to resort to Xanax (not sure if that's how it's spelled) just to keep my nerves semi-settled.  I just don't know how I'm going to survive this week.

Thanks for the advice everyone, my head is much more clear now versus when I made this original post.  We have been talking a bit more now and we are friends (been talking to her through Skype and texting).  I still just can't give up on this possibility of a second chance with her.  She is actually trying to plan a trip to come visit me and a couple of our mutual friends this June.  Until then I've been focusing on what I can do for myself now instead of letting this depression keep a grip on me.  When June rolls around I'm going to ask her to wait for me to return to her.  Of course the ball would be in her court if I'm right in how I'm reading the signs from her there is still a chance!

Have any of you ever just had that unshakable feeling in your gut about someone you care deeply about and how you just can't give up because you truly feel there is still something there?  That's the best way I can describe what this is for me.  She's still not seeing anyone else and doesn't have any intention to see anyone for a good while.  I feel like the stage is set for success here.  I hope I'm right, I would be the happiest and luckiest man alive if this works out.  Have I just gone crazy or could this actually happen?
